The present anticipatory bail application has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in case crime No.0105 of 2018 under sections 409, 419, 420 I.P.C., Police Station Barasagwar, district Unnao.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned Additional Government Advocate for the State.

Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the complaint regarding sub-standard construction of toilets was duly enquired into by the department, and thereafter, the complaint was consigned to record.

However, despite the said departmental findings, the Investigating Officer, after completion of investigation, has filed a charge sheet under Sections 419 and 409 IPC, and cognizance has been taken by the court.

It is further submitted that the applicant has no criminal history, the charge sheet has already been filed, and the applicant has cooperated during the course of investigation and undertakes to cooperate in the trial as well.
Learned counsel for the applicant co-accused Siyadhar has been granted regular bail by this court vide order dated 16.10.2025 passed in Bail Application No.10120 of 2025.
Learned Addl.
Government Advocate has opposed the prayer made by applicant's counsel.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter and upon perusal of the record, it is evident that the applicant has no criminal history.

Taking into account the undertaking given on behalf of the applicant that he shall cooperate in the trial, the fact that the charge sheet has already been filed,
and also considering the judgment of the Hon?ble Supreme Court in Musheer Alam vs. State of U.P.
and another, 2025 SCC OnLine SC 116, and without entering into the merits of the case, this Court finds it appropriate to extend the benefit of protection to the applicant.
